review_candidates.title: Site Engineer
review_candidates.location: Port Moresby, National Capital District, Papua New Guinea
review_candidates.description: Key Responsibilities Provide day-to-day site supervision as the Site Supervision Engineer (Electrical Engineer) for construction and erection of the transmission line and substation works. Supervise electrical installation activities to ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, standards, and ITPs (including but not limited to HV equipment, earthing/grounding, cable works, terminations, and protection & control interfaces, as applicable). Coordinate closely with the Transmission Line Engineer, Substation Engineer and Civil Engineer to manage work fronts, interfaces, and sequencing (civil–electrical, primary–secondary, and contractor–client interfaces). Monitor contractor progress and productivity; verify quantities and percent complete against the schedule; identify constraints and escalate risks/issues early. Maintain accurate site records including daily site diary, labour/plant records, inspection checklists, test records, photos, and as-built mark-ups as required by the project. Undertake site verification of works completed by the contractor, including dimensional checks, installation verification, and witnessing inspections/tests at hold/witness points. Support quality management by promptly identifying non-conformances, raising NCRs/defect lists as required, and coordinating close-out with the contractor and project team. Support HSE compliance by ensuring safe work practices are followed on site, participating in toolbox talks and inspections, and escalating unsafe conditions/stop-work situations in line with project procedures. Assist with verification of contractor claims and variations with the procurement/commercial team by providing measurement sheets, progress evidence, and supporting documentation. Contribute to testing and commissioning readiness activities by confirming installation completeness, punch-listing, and supporting pre-commissioning checks and documentation compilation (as directed by the project team). Carry out other necessary site supervision and coordination duties required to meet project objectives. Key Performance Indicators Safety performance: All safety observations/close-outs completed within agreed timeframes. Construction progress monitoring: weekly progress updates issued on time (e.g., by end of each week) with accurate % complete vs plan and key constraints/escalations logged. Quality/ITP compliance: inspection and test plan (ITP) hold/witness points attended as required; NCRs raised within 24–48 hours of identification and closed out within agreed timeframes. Site verification accuracy: field measurements/checks completed to plan; verification records are complete, signed, and traceable (e.g., daily reports, inspection checklists, photos). Daily site records: daily site diary/report submitted on time with labour/plant, work fronts, weather, issues/risks, and HSE/quality notes (target: 100% compliance). Coordination/support to engineers: requests from transmission line/substation/civil engineers actioned within agreed SLAs; technical queries and site issues escalated promptly with recommended options. Contractor management: non-conformances, delays, and unsafe practices identified early and communicated formally; reduction in repeat issues month-on-month. Claims/variation support: measurement sheets and supporting evidence provided to procurement/commercial team by agreed cut-off dates; disputed quantities/variations resolved with clear substantiation. Variation control: potential variations identified and notified early (e.g., within 2 working days of becoming aware) with scope, cause, and preliminary cost/time impact. Stakeholder communication: site coordination meetings attended; actions captured and closed within due dates (target: >90% on-time close-out). Documentation quality: all submitted reports/records meet project document control requirements (correct templates, revision control, minimal rework/returns). Key Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills & Experience A bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering and has a minimum of 3 years of work experience in construction supervision for at least one transmission & substation project and/or distribution and household connection projects [as applicable] Proven ability to work in multicultural teams and, where applicable, coordinate with international distribution specialists and stakeholders. Competent in interpreting drawings and using common engineering tools (e.g., AutoCAD and Microsoft Office; power system tools/GIS advantageous). Strong reporting, communication and mentoring skills; commitment to safety and field-based work. At Surbana Jurong, we put talent, hard work, teamwork and a fun workplace together to approach problems and solve them creatively and collaboratively. Join us in making a positive impact on the world!

Cette plateforme porte des services data, voix, SMS pour IoT, et est constituée d’un cœur mobile 4G/5G, et d’un cœur voix IMS, d’un SMSC, le tout déployés dans un environnement Kubernetes Vos compétences de routage et troubleshooting vos permettront d’assurer le support sur les différents services déjà déployés Vous allez travailler en étroite collaboration, avec une équipe pluridisciplinaire fonctionnant en méthodologie Agile, et dans un contexte internationale avec les équipes d’Orange Wholesale afin de recueillir leurs besoins et les contraintes spécifiques associées Compétences requises: De formation ingénieur en informatique ou en télécom, vous avez une expérience de 5 à 8 ans dans un poste similaire, dans le monde opérateurs ou fournisseurs. Compétences et qualités exigées: Troubleshooting et Investigation sur des problèmes complexes sur le cœur mobile data / voix, SMS via des tests fonctionnels et protocolaires avec vision E2E et proposition de résolution avec les équipes expertes des composants CNaaS, Voice, Signalling/messaging. Tests et validation des nouveaux services IoT E2E attendus par le marketing Participation aux travaux d’intégration/ validation/ upgrade des éléments de la plate-forme (cœur mobile 4G/5G, cœur voix IMS, SMSC) en soutien aux équipes TMC concernées Soutien pour l’automatisation des opérations récurrentes d’exploitation ou de tests via des outils DevOps. Mise en place, configuration et optimisation des outils d’observabilité (monitoring, logging, alerting) et participation à l’intégration avec outillage des équipes opérations/supervision Suivi de la performance et la stabilité des différentes instances de plate-formes IoT(qualification/pré-prod / production) Participation à l’amélioration continue des processus d’intégration et de déploiement. Connaissance approfondie des réseaux mobiles 4G/5G et de l’IMS Expérience en intégration de solutions telco mobile voix/data/sms entre elles, composants par composants (intégration horizontale) Connaissance de Kubernetes et des environnements cloud natifs Expérience en intégration de solutions telco mobile dans un environnement virtualisé ou containerisé (intégration verticale) Capacités d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes complexes Expérience avec les outils d’observabilité ( Prometheus, Grafana, ELK , etc.). Compétences en DevOps : CI/CD, automatisation des déploiements, gestion des configurations. Compétences en scripting et développement pour automatiser les opérations. Connaissances en sécurité et gestion des incidents Aptitudes relationnelles et comportementales : Être en mesure de jouer le rôle d’expert et de leader Capacité d’analyse et esprit de synthèse Capacité à travailler en équipe et à transférer l’information Bonnes qualités relationnelles Aptitude à la communication, au dialogue, au partage du savoir Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et à prendre des décisions éclairées Description de la compétence : Savoir transmettre, échanger, et partager de l’information écrite et orale de façon claire, tout en s’adaptant à ses interlocuteurs. Autonomie, rigueur, sens du résultat, motivation et capacité à être force de proposition, Capacité à travailler efficacement avec des équipes multidisciplinaires et à communiquer les concepts techniques de manière claire et compréhensible. L'environnent international dans lequel évolue Sofrecom, implique la parfaite maitrise du français et anglais tant à l'écrit qu'à l'oral

review_candidates.title: GFAC Project Planning Engineer – Schedule, Cashflow, & AI
review_candidates.description: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. The GFAC Project Planning Engineer – Schedule, Cashflow, & AI role offers an outstanding opportunity to develop the future of Micron's construction projects by driving innovation and excellence. This position is perfect for ambitious individuals who are passionate about using advanced technologies to achieve world-class project planning and execution. You will be responsible for establishing and maintaining project planning governance, forecasting standards, reporting systems, and digital solutions that support Micron North Asia construction projects. The role will lead schedule and cashflow governance processes, develop forecasting models, and drive automation initiatives to improve project visibility, reporting efficiency, and decision-making. The position serves as a key enabler for delivering consistent planning methodologies, reliable forecasts, and data-driven insights across Micron's construction portfolio. Responsibility includes managing and improving planning business processes, developing automation solutions, maintaining enterprise reporting systems, and providing accurate and timely project performance information to stakeholders and management teams. Responsibilities and Tasks Schedule Governance Develop and maintain project scheduling guidelines, procedures, and planning methodologies. Coordinate periodic schedule updates across multiple projects and collaborators. Review and validate schedule quality, logic, and forecasting assumptions. Analyze schedule performance and identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities. Support schedule recovery planning and forecasting activities. Cashflow Governance Consolidate project cashflow forecasts across the construction portfolio. Review forecast accuracy and monitor project spending performance. Analyze variances between forecasted and actual expenditures. Establish and maintain cashflow planning standards and reporting processes. Support long-range planning (LRP) and financial forecasting activities. Modeling & Scenario Planning Develop schedule, cost, and cashflow forecasting models. Perform scenario analysis and simulation to support business planning. Assess project planning assumptions and conduct sensitivity analysis. Support planning efforts and project evaluation studies. Automation & Applying Artificial Intelligence Reporting Build and keep up Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions. Build automation tools and workflows to improve planning efficiency and data quality. Manage SharePoint governance and project reporting platforms. Standardize reporting processes and establish data governance practices. Support digital transformation initiatives within Project Controls and Planning functions. Collaborator Management Collaborate with project managers, project controls, finance, procurement, and site teams. Prepare project performance reports and executive management presentations. Maintain effective communication with collaborators to ensure alignment of planning assumptions and reporting requirements. Ensure planning roles, responsibilities, and accountabilities are clearly understood across project teams. Bringing to bear Artificial Intelligence Integrate AI-assisted tools and insights into planning, forecasting, reporting, and automation activities to improve project performance and operational efficiency. Identify and implement AI-enabled opportunities for schedule analysis, forecasting, reporting automation, and knowledge management. Contribute to the adoption of AI-enabled work practices by developing and sharing innovative solutions within the planning organization. Apply digital proficiency and AI literacy to perform research, analysis, content generation, process automation, and problem-solving while aligning with organizational standards and legal requirements. Minimum Experience & Skills Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Data Analytics, or related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in Project Controls, Project Planning, Scheduling, or Construction Management. Strong knowledge of scheduling, cashflow forecasting, and portfolio reporting. Experience developing dashboards, reporting systems, and business intelligence solutions. Proficiency in Excel, Power BI, Power Query, Power Automate, VBA, Python, or similar automation tools preferred. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience supporting large capital construction projects is highly desired. Ability to work effectively within a global multicultural environment. Excellent communication and collaborator management skills. Language: Mandarin and English required; Japanese is preferred. Join us in this ambitious role and help us successfully implement flawless project planning methodologies that set the standard for excellence at Micron! About Micron Technology, Inc. We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all . With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience. To learn more, please visit micron.com/careers All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. To request assistance with the application process and/or for reasonable accommodations, please contact at hrsupport_taiwan@micron.com. Micron Prohibits the use of child labor and complies with all applicable laws, rules, regulations, and other international and industry labor standards. Micron does not charge candidates any recruitment fees or unlawfully collect any other payment from candidates as consideration for their employment with Micron. AI alert: Candidates are encouraged to use AI tools to enhance their resume and/or application materials. However, all information provided must be accurate and reflect the candidate's true skills and experiences. Misuse of AI to fabricate or misrepresent qualifications will result in immediate disqualification. Detalles del cliente Empresa líder en mantenimiento de infraestructuras, obra civil e instalaciones, especializada en la gestión de contratos de conservación urbana, alumbrado público, edificios e infraestructuras, tanto para clientes públicos como privados, con un fuerte enfoque en la calidad, la eficiencia y la sostenibilidad. Oficinas en Barcelona. Descripción de la oferta En dependencia directa de la Dirección General, asumirás la gestión integral del P&L de una delegación de Catalunya conformada por contratos de mantenimiento urbano, obra civil, instalaciones y servicios a infraestructuras, mayoritariamente para la Administración Pública. Entre las principales responsabilidades destacan: Liderarás la gestión integral de una de las delegaciones de Catalunya, asumiendo la responsabilidad total sobre la cuenta de resultados y el cumplimiento de los objetivos de negocio. Garantizarás la rentabilidad de la actividad mediante el control del margen bruto, EBITDA, tesorería y generación de caja. Dirigirás una cartera de 10-15 contratos de mantenimiento de infraestructuras urbanas, obra civil, alumbrado público, mantenimiento integral de edificios e instalaciones, principalmente para el sector público y de alrededor de 15M €. Supervisarás la ejecución operativa, económica y contractual de los servicios, asegurando el cumplimiento de los niveles de calidad, plazos, costes y compromisos adquiridos con el cliente. Liderarás a un equipo numeroso personas, formado por responsables de área, jefes de contrato y equipos técnicos y administrativos, promoviendo una cultura de responsabilidad, excelencia y orientación a resultados. Elaborarás y harás seguimiento de los presupuestos anuales, analizando periódicamente los indicadores de gestión y definiendo acciones correctoras ante posibles desviaciones. Impulsarás iniciativas de mejora continua, eficiencia operativa y optimización de recursos para maximizar la rentabilidad de los contratos. Actuarás como principal interlocutor y representante de la empresa ante ayuntamientos, administraciones públicas, organismos oficiales y clientes estratégicos, construyendo relaciones de confianza a largo plazo. Identificarás oportunidades de crecimiento en los contratos existentes, promoviendo la ampliación de servicios y la generación de negocio recurrente. Colaborarás con el equipo de licitaciones públicas, aportando visión operativa, económica y conocimiento del cliente. Supervisarás la planificación de recursos humanos, materiales, maquinaria y subcontratas, garantizando una utilización eficiente de todos los medios disponibles. Negociarás con proveedores y colaboradores estratégicos para optimizar costes y asegurar la calidad del servicio. Velarás por el cumplimiento de la normativa en materia de calidad, medio ambiente, prevención de riesgos laborales y compliance. Perfil ideal Titulación superior en Ingeniería de Caminos, Canales y Puertos, Ingeniería Industrial o similares. The mandate is to build a market — developing the relationships, commercial channels and strategic partnerships through which Trade Admire Group can establish a long-term presence in Libya. The successful candidate will play an important role in building the foundation for Trade Admire Group’s wider North Africa and international growth strategy . review_candidates.description: Mace combines construction expertise with consultancy to unlock potential in every person or project and redefine the boundaries of ambition. Our values shape the way we consult and define the people we want to join us on our journey. A subject matter expert driving best‑in‑class PMO and project controls, strengthening Mace’s profile and client confidence. The Cost Engineer delivers robust cost management across PMO or delivery teams, coordinating stakeholders and ensuring compliant operations. Please Note: This role will be based anywhere in the UK and require ad hoc travel across. You’ll Be Responsible For Delivering accurate cost monitoring, forecasting and reporting. Supporting full budget, scope, change control and earned value analysis. Coordinating with scheduling, commercial, construction and finance teams. Assuring monthly cost data and variance analysis. Driving forecast and budget accuracy. Producing clear cost reports. Applying strong cost and contract management. Building effective client and partner relationships. You’ll Need To Have Achieved professional qualification through recognised body (e.g. APM, AACE, A Cost E etc). Proven relevant experience in project management or project controls environment in a similar cost role in a construction or consultancy background. Experience in a regulated infrastructure sector. Our values Safety first - Going home safe and well: We champion a safe, diverse and inclusive working environment, understanding the importance of wellbeing in every team. Client focus - Deliver on our promise: We own the quality of deliverables, strategic outcomes and build long term relationships with our clients. Integrity - Always do the right thing: We influence positive outcomes within our industry, while always aligning with our compliance obligations. Create opportunity - For our people to excel: We champion a continuous improvement culture throughout all activities, inspiring our people and teams to develop. Mace is an inclusive employer and welcomes interest from a diverse range of candidates. Even if you feel you do not fulfil all the criteria, please apply as you may still be the best candidate for this role or another role within our organisation. We are also open to discussing part time, flexible, and hybrid working options if suitable with-in the role.
